'''Slone Maddow''' is a [[Redarm]] in [[Matrim Cauthon]]'s [[Band of the Red Hand]].

== Appearance ==
He has wide ears.

== Activities ==
He informs Mat that [[Olver]] is with [[Noal Charin]] after the [[gholam]] attack outside [[Caemlyn]].

==Trivia==
*Slone Maddow is named after John Sloan, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
